value.rationale: Beyond the known leading cap-volume term, the nontrivial positive next coefficient resolves the relative transverse first and second moments of two arbitrary (possibly nonsimplicial) diametral vertex cones. This is a natural invariant of extreme random Euclidean distances and supplies a reproducible shape-sensitive quantitative correction for every polytope in every dimension, with no unique longest-chord assumption.
